text: I put the lettuce back because it cost more than the chicken, and I put the chicken back because it was next, and now I am home with a salad spinner full of nothing but the idea of dinner.
name: Deshawn Phelps

text: My grandmother says she remembers when a dollar was a dollar. I told her my fare just went up and she said enjoy it now because that bus you ride is the last thing money was ever for.
name: Iris Calloway

text: The rent, the fare, and the groceries all meet once a month to decide which of me gets the check. This month they split it three ways and mailed the change to the baby formula people.
name: Marisol Neri
